authorization.user_start_evidence: User explicitly requested on 2026-07-28: 你把这些数据收集过来，看看够不够
authorization.authorized_action: Collect and mechanically verify the bounded first-wave candidate data below, then determine whether it is sufficient.

required_content: issuer and security identity
exchange-qualified code history
listing, transfer and delisting episode dates
security type and board
direct official source record identifiers and revision observations
exchange trading-day flags
holiday and exceptional-closure observations
session schedule and effective dates
source publication or revision observations where exposed
event class and lifecycle status
announcement, record, ex, effective and payment dates as applicable
cash, share, rights, split, consolidation and other adjustment terms as applicable
direct document or record identity
publication evidence and correction, cancellation or supersession links
suspension and resumption episodes
ST and other risk-warning episodes
IPO, relisting and delisting transition states
price-limit and no-price-limit rule versions with effective dates
board or security-class eligibility and exception rules
official source identity and exact endpoint or document location
public access and local-retention terms visible at collection time
internal research use boundary
retrieval timestamp, request parameters and payload hash

mandatory_exports.reason: Create a non-overlapping history extension before the existing 2020-2024 candidate.
Replace the existing January-only 2025 sample with a bounded current extension.
Replace the three-field pilot with a complete current company/security cross-section candidate.
Provide a structured calendar candidate for comparison with official exchange calendars.

target_families: corporate action terms, lifecycle and revisions
price-limit rule or status code dictionaries
census_then_selected_export.selection_rule: Export only tables whose visible metadata contains direct fields needed to close CORE-01, CORE-04 or CORE-06; record all rejected alternatives and the reason.

eligible_tables: the already-selected identity, action and status tables
execute_only_if_all: Mandatory 2015-through-current collection and mechanical verification have completed.

The identity-and-calendar-aligned daily candidate has fewer than 1856 distinct usable trading dates, or no contiguous selected-universe segment reaches 1856 dates, or the action/status boundary-event matrix lacks a pre-2015 observation required to interpret a post-2015 episode.
No critical rights, identity, date, unit, primary-key or revision-chain conflict is open for the table being extended.
The storage and request guards remain satisfied before every export.
conditional_extension.reason: Conditional robustness extension only; it is not a general full-history authorization.

explicitly_out_of_scope: any paid source, new subscription, purchase or credential use
news bodies, bulk PDFs and high-frequency or tick data
GCTX, HK and GLEQ bulk backfill
factor IC, backtest, portfolio simulation or investment conclusion

storage_guard.rule: The user imposed no fixed free-space reserve. The engineering hard guard remains the earlier of 240 GiB new footprint or falling below 25% free space.
storage_guard.measurement: Use filesystem-reported physical bytes; measure before the first write, before each export batch and after each candidate build.

provenance_minimum: exact URL, portal table identity or official document identity
source-visible publication or effective timestamp with precision

daily_candidate: primary key uniqueness by permanent-security candidate and trade date
OHLC non-negativity and high-low envelope checks
volume and amount units preserved and compared across periods
NULL and sentinel frequencies reported without coercion
date coverage, security coverage and discontinuity diagnostics
overlap comparison for 2020-2024 and January 2025 without silent overwrite
identity_calendar_action_status: every accepted code episode maps to one provisional permanent-security candidate for its effective interval
official calendar conflicts remain explicit and are not resolved by observed trade dates alone
corporate-action terms retain event, record, ex, effective and payment date distinctions
each correction, cancellation or supersession claim has direct evidence
status episodes and rule versions have explicit effective intervals
cross-source conflicts are quarantined with source precedence undecided unless direct official evidence closes them
rights: record visible terms and collection boundary
do not infer redistribution rights from browser access
stop formal admission when local retention or internal research use remains unclear

minimum_required: CORE-01 candidate permanent identity and code-history closure for the selected universe and dates
CORE-02 official trading calendar and session-history closure
CORE-03 unadjusted daily observations aligned to identity and calendar with critical field semantics resolved
CORE-04 corporate-action terms and revision evidence sufficient to reproduce adjustment inputs
CORE-06 historical status and rule-version evidence sufficient to define tradability
at least 1856 distinct identity-and-calendar-aligned usable trading dates
no critical primary-key, OHLC, unit, identity, calendar, action-term, revision or status-rule conflict
at least 1856 usable trading dates after identity/calendar alignment
80/10/10 split leaves at least 180 validation dates

missing_after_scope: PIT financial facts with initial publication and revision chains
historical shares, float shares and valuation inputs
admitted benchmark and index constituent histories

sufficiency_matrix.reason: This is a bounded CORE-01/02/03/04/06 source-closure batch, not a full planned-database backfill.
Formal source admission, immutable research snapshots, D2B, L2 PIT and leakage gates, and a separately authorized factor run remain required.

hard_stop_conditions: A paid tier, new subscription, purchase, credential, token or secret is required.
A CAPTCHA or authentication loss occurs; pause for the user and do not bypass it.
HTTP 429, explicit rate limiting, access denial or source terms prohibit the planned collection.
Local retention or internal research use cannot be bounded from direct evidence.
The selected portal table identity or visible field metadata does not match the planned family.
An official endpoint cannot be reproduced from the official page or has unverified request serialization.
A raw response is an error, login or challenge page instead of the expected business payload.
A critical identity, exchange, date, timezone, unit, primary-key, OHLC, corporate-action-term, revision-chain or rule-version conflict cannot be conservatively quarantined.
Projected or measured free space falls below 25% of the G drive.
The formal catalog SHA-256 differs from the frozen value.
The next action would exceed the exact table, date, request, file or byte scope in this plan.
quarantine_conditions: unknown, conflicting or undocumented field semantics
ambiguous permanent identity or overlapping code episodes
date-only publication evidence where an intraday available_at would be required
corporate-action record without complete terms or direct revision evidence
status code without an effective-dated official rule version
source conflict that lacks direct official closure
duplicate or overlapping export whose precedence cannot be proven

required: Every mandatory Track A family has a coverage report, direct-source provenance and explicit unresolved-gap list for 2015-01-01 through 2026-07-28.
Every mandatory Track B export has an exact source package manifest, raw hash, visible table metadata receipt and mechanical verification result.
The selected action and status table census records accepted and rejected tables.
The conditional 2010-2014 decision is recorded as EXECUTED_WITH_TRIGGER or NOT_EXECUTED_WITH_REASON.
The storage guard and formal catalog guard pass.
Candidate paths remain INSPECTION_ONLY, NOT_ADMITTED and rejected by qdata research intent.
The sufficiency matrix records PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED with measured evidence for each use case.
No factor IC, backtest, efficacy or investment conclusion is produced.

report_to_user: what was actually downloaded and built
whether the initial price-volume candidate base meets every stated sufficiency condition
what remains missing for classic A-share multifactor work
whether the 2010-2014 conditional extension was triggered
the exact next package requiring separate authorization
